sector.quote: The group operates a construction materials and home products retail business under the trade name We MAKE and "Riki Riki" , a ready-mixed and precast concrete manufacturing and distribution business under the trade name 'SC', and an industrial granite mining business for use in the construction industry.

business_description.value: The group runs a construction materials and home products retail business (We MAKE and "Riki Riki"), manufactures and distributes ready-mixed and precast concrete under the 'SC' name, and mines industrial granite for the construction industry.
